description:
Her long-time boyfriend and her best friend’s infidelity. Lee Bom loses both love and friendship due to their betrayal. Just as the 50 million won her ex-boyfriend borrowed vanishes, a suspicious man named Baek Do-Hyeok appears.

*“You know, when what you’ve let slip through your fingers seems to shine brighter, you end up looking back for it.”*

Baek Do-Hyeok proposes that she win back her ex-boyfriend Park U-Sung’s heart to get the money back. And so begins a precarious fake relationship. But is there a hidden agenda behind this relationship from the very beginning..? 

(Source: Naver, translated)
